title: 第3章【冥婚】马天
slug: 诡异副本勇敢者的游戏
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

马天朝着院子内缓缓走了进来，顾原的心几乎提到了嗓子眼，但幸运的是马天的双眼丢失，似乎并没有看到自己。

只不过，除了马天的鼻子外，他那青黑色的耳朵也一动一动，像是在捕捉可能出现的动静。

“咚......咚咚......”

顾原后背一凉，头皮几乎炸开，他低着头看向自己身前的棺材。

如此安静的环境下，即使是自己的心跳声都被放大了无数倍，更何况还是这种敲击声。

最重要的是，这敲击声还来自眼前的棺材。

顾原有些欲哭无泪，今天自己是必须死吗？

听到声音的马天身子一动，就朝着棺材走了过来。

“我去，这方清怎么死了也不放过我。”

顾原心里想着，朝着棺材后面退了几步。

马天耳朵一动，鼻子抽了抽，脚步猛的加快，显然刚才顾原的动静引起了马天的注意。

马天一下朝着顾原抓了过来，好在顾原的反应够快，向后一退躲了过去，但没想到这一下马天正好抓到了棺材，他的力气极大，一下子将棺材差点都给掀翻，看的顾原心惊肉跳。

此刻，棺材落到地上，棺盖有了一点缝隙，不等顾原有所反应，就看到棺材缝隙中间一只纤细的手伸了出来。

“顾原哥，你怎么才来啊。”

棺材中的声音听起来有些怨愤，像是一个许久未见情郎的女子，但顾原听到却是后背一凉。

紧接着马天一把抓住纤细的手腕，另外一只手掀开棺盖，一把将尸体拽了出来。

【姓名：方清】

【身份：新娘】

此刻，顾原脑海中也想到了自己的任务，那就是与新娘完成冥婚，并且带走新娘，自己才能完成任务活下去。

可要是现在新娘被马天带走，那么自己就只有死路一条。

绝不能让他带走方清。

否则完不成任务还是一死，他可不想再面对那个西装男。

想到这里，顾原的胆子大了起来。

但随着顾原脚下一动，马天原本要离开的身子忽的停住了，接着耳朵动了几下就朝着顾原扑了过来。

开什么玩笑！

好在顾原经常锻炼，他的反应够快，在马天扑过来的一瞬间一个侧闪多了过去，但没想到的是马天的动作更快。

在他落地后片刻，脚下发力再度冲了过来，而这一次顾原已经没有躲避的可能，只能正面硬抗。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ma Tian walked slowly into the yard. Gu Yuan's heart almost rose to his throat, but luckily Ma Tian's eyes were lost and he didn't seem to see him.

However, in addition to Ma Tian's nose, his green-black ears also moved, as if catching possible movements.

"Dong...dong dong..."

Gu Yuan's back felt cold and his scalp almost exploded. He lowered his head and looked at the coffin in front of him.

In such a quiet environment, even the sound of his own heartbeat was amplified countless times, not to mention this kind of knocking sound.

The most important thing is that the knocking sound comes from the coffin in front of me.

Gu Yuan felt like crying, did he have to die today?

Ma Tian moved when he heard the sound and walked towards the coffin.

"I'll go. Even if Fang Qing dies, he won't let me go."

Gu Yuan thought to himself and took a few steps back behind the coffin.

Ma Tian's ears twitched, his nose twitched, and his steps quickened. It was obvious that Gu Yuan's movements just now caught Ma Tian's attention.

Ma Tian immediately grabbed Gu Yuan. Fortunately, Gu Yuan reacted quickly enough and stepped back to avoid it. But he didn't expect that Ma Tian just caught the coffin. His strength was so great that he almost overturned the coffin. Gu Yuan was shocked to see it.

At this moment, the coffin fell to the ground, and there was a slight gap in the coffin lid. Before Gu Yuan could react, he saw a slender hand stretching out from the middle of the gap in the coffin.

"Brother Gu Yuan, why did you come here?"

The voice in the coffin sounded a little resentful, like a woman who hadn't seen her lover for a long time, but Gu Yuan felt a chill running down his spine when he heard it.

Then Ma Tian grabbed the slender wrist, opened the coffin lid with the other hand, and pulled the body out.

[Name: Fang Qing]

[Identity: Bride]

At this moment, Gu Yuan also thought about his mission, which was to complete the ghost marriage with the bride and take the bride away so that he could complete the mission and survive.

But if the bride is taken away by Ma Tian now, then he will only die.

He must not be allowed to take Fang Qing away.

Otherwise, he would die if he failed to complete the task. He didn't want to face the man in the suit again.

Thinking of this, Gu Yuan became bolder.

But as Gu Yuan's feet moved, Ma Tian's body that was about to leave suddenly stopped, and then he moved his ears a few times and rushed towards Gu Yuan.

What a joke!

Fortunately, Gu Yuan exercised regularly, and his reaction was fast enough. When Ma Tian pounced on him, he sidestepped past him, but what he didn't expect was that Ma Tian moved faster.

A moment after he landed, he rushed towards him again with the force of his feet, but this time Gu Yuan had no possibility of evading and could only resist head-on.
